## [1.1.0](https://github.com/Nich87/nich87-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-08)

### ✨ New Features

* Add Apple Music library metadata repair ([e430e30](https://github.com/Nich87/nich87-patches/commit/e430e30026a3e7a636bd5b118756c64910a6aa63))
* Add Liquid Glass mini-player and touch feedback ([28cc544](https://github.com/Nich87/nich87-patches/commit/28cc5442888931cc3e5952e3eb66a1b6840392a1))

patches.name: Library import, export and downloads
patches.description: Adds JSON library and playlist backups, additive import, and a native download action for the entire library.

patches.name: Liquid Glass bottom bar
patches.description: Adds live refractive glass to Apple Music's mini-player and bottom tabs, with whole-bar touch feedback, drag parallax and an animated selection lens. Refraction requires Android 13 or newer.

patches.name: Repair Japanese library metadata
patches.description: Finds romanized library metadata and repairs selected songs using Japanese catalog data, preserving library entries and syncing changes to the account.
